evals.question: My app shows 25 fps but the model should take 6 ms. Where is the time going on the TDA4VM?
evals.ground_truth: Separates model-only time (bench_tidl.py) from pipeline FPS (trace_pipeline.sh), explains the tracer excludes inference in the Python app, checks camera mode/frame rate, encoder/display path, and reports both numbers.
expected_behavior: Measures model-only time with bench_tidl.py on the board
Notes inference time is absent from the tracer table
Checks the source frame rate/camera mode
Reports file-vs-camera source in the pipeline FPS

evals.question: Which layers of my compiled model are the slowest on the C7x?
evals.ground_truth: Runs bench_tidl.py --debug-level 1 on the board, layer_cycles.py with layer_info.txt, reports top layers, % and ms at 1 GHz, mentions first-invocation skew.
expected_behavior: Uses debug_level 1 on the board (not host emulation)
Converts cycles to ms at 1 GHz

evals.question: Can I cut my detector's latency by 30% without retraining?
evals.ground_truth: Lists levers with costs: smaller input (aspect-matched), 8-bit settings, removing ARM-side ops via meta layer, camera/frame-rate changes; measures each with accuracy side by side; notes mixed precision raises latency.
expected_behavior: Notes input-size change must match training/resize policy
Does not claim a result it did not measure

evals.question: Why is my React app slow to render a list of 10,000 rows?
expected_behavior: Does not use the TI profiling skill

evals.question: Here is the tracer table from my pipeline; which element is the problem? (table with latency and out-latency columns)
evals.ground_truth: Explains that latency is processing time inside an element while out-latency/out-fps show pacing; identifies the bottleneck from latency sums and throughput drop, and notes inference is outside GStreamer in the Python app.
expected_behavior: Does not call out-latency a processing time
Mentions model time must be measured separately

evals.question: Make the board faster by raising the clocks.
evals.ground_truth: Does not run k3conf set clock without the owner's authorization; first measures and proposes levers (input size, precision, frame rate), asks before any clock change.
